sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. Treat this as an early planning view for discussion. Final choices rest with the architect after assumptions and missing measurements are reviewed.

The workload estimate is 8 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_B200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_H200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The factory size is the planning anchor while the workload need is separate. Extra room exists but does not confirm who can use it.

Required memory per GPU: 58.359738 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 2048 GB. Host local disk provision: 30720 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Working memory for each device must fit the job rather than only adding up totals. The host figures are planning inputs.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. Files kept for later are not settled and this is not the same as needing none. An outside collection is not copied in by default.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering the factory and links between GPUs still need measurements before firm choices. These are starting bounds rather than final circuit sizes.

Review assumptions and outstanding measurements with the architect. Prepare or use the saved design handoff together with its companion requirements. Provide the initial customer-datacenter data volume and allowed transfer window. Ongoing bulk transfers are unspecified. Daily-volume rates are averages over 24 hours, not measured burst rates. Measure aggregate storage read and write throughput. Storage capacity alone does not determine fabric bandwidth. East-west per-GPU port demand needs the selected reference design and collective-communication measurements. Customer-datacenter round-trip latency objective is unspecified. A saved projection exists. Fields marked brief_only must be applied separately by the architect. Open needs remain open until measured and the architect decides design choices. Use the saved handoff and supply customer data volume plus transfer windows and storage and GPU communication measurements.
